value.title: Truthful Copilot and OMP Model Catalogs
value.summary: Make pij report and validate the model catalogs of the target runtime rather than conflating upstream providers with harnesses.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Copilot CLI accepts actual entitled API IDs, while OMP accepts provider-qualified client selectors including base and -1m variants. The registry will model runtime and upstream provider separately, load OMP's effective no-refresh catalog without binding to its SQLite cache, select the matching catalog for CLI output and spawn validation, and fail honestly when OMP inventory is unavailable.

sections.name: goals
value: Expose truthful Copilot CLI and OMP runtime catalogs without confusing API IDs with client selectors.
Select the target runtime catalog for model and effort validation while preserving warn-don't-block spawning.
Keep Pi proxy-provider, Claude, and Codex behavior intact.
Remove committed OMP overrides that collapse base and -1m context variants.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Refreshing OMP models over the network or binding to its SQLite cache schema.
Changing installed OMP/Copilot binaries or global user configuration.
Merging the branch or reconstructing the canonical checkout's local llama-server provider.

value.claim: pij models --harness copilot includes gpt-5.6-sol-fast with 1,050,000 context and none/low/medium/high/xhigh/max efforts.
Copilot output and validation reject OMP-only *-1m selectors as known Copilot CLI IDs.
pij models --harness omp lists base and -1m Luna, Sol, Sol Fast, and Terra selectors with distinct contexts and exact provider-qualified selectors.
value.receipt: eight-row live OMP projection + parser tests

value.claim: JSON identifies target runtime separately from upstream provider and retains the exact selector callers pass.
Unavailable or malformed OMP inventory produces a non-success result rather than an authoritative empty catalog.

value.title: Implement runtime-specific model catalogs
value.brief: RED tests first, then extend the registry and CLI composition so runtime is a first-class catalog dimension.
value.objective: Make catalog reporting and validation truthful for Copilot CLI, OMP, and Pi.
delivers: OMP effective-catalog loader with explicit failure
value.key_risks: OMP command output can be unavailable or locally overridden; fail loudly and parse structurally without refreshing.
